content: We categorize the 10% test dataset into different categories based on the complexity and type of the data and analyze the breakdown of the system's performance in Table TABREF11. We breakdown the Frequency extraction into two categories, 1) None: ground truth Frequency tag is `none', and 2) NN (Not None): ground truth Frequency tag is not `none'. Similarly, the Dosage extraction into 5 categories, 1) None: ground truth dosage tag is `none', 2) MM (Multiple Medicine): input segment has more than one Medication mentioned, 3) MN (Multiple Numbers): input segment has more than one number present, and 4) NBM (Number between correct Dosage and Medicine) : between the Medication Name and the correct Dosage in the input segment there are other numbers present. Note that the categories of the Dosage extraction task are not exhaustive, and one tag can belong to multiple categories.
